New York's Diamond District: a one-carat diamond now sells for $3,898, down 51% from its 2021 average of $8,007.

The Diamond Standard Index hit 2,490 in early August, its lowest level ever, as lab-grown diamonds now sell for as little as $450 against $2,800 to $3,200 for the same natural stone.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Gold in New York today: $4,284.20 an ounce, from the 25 September tape close, unchanged.
